description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButtonQuickCreate, which is a specialized widget for rendering a quick create button form in the subpanel top section of the SuiteCRM interface. It extends SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton and provides methods to generate the HTML form for quick creation of related records, including handling additional form fields and determining the subpanel relationship name.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButtonQuickCreate
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a quick create button form in subpanels, facilitating inline creation of related records in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML form string used for the quick create button, embedding necessary hidden fields and form attributes based on given definitions and context.

methods.name: get_subpanel_relationship_name
methods.description: Determines and returns the relationship name associated with a subpanel based on its definition, considering data source name and bean field relationships.
